empty: Drop a link here or press “Add”

st.unverified: Complete · not verified (server sent no ETag)
st.changed: The file changed on the server · old part kept
st.foreignPart: The .part file was replaced · GDM leaves it alone
st.diskFull: Not enough disk space (1 GB kept free)
st.sizeExceeded: Larger than the set limit · continue?
st.insecure: The server tried an unsafe route
st.tls: The server's certificate is not valid
st.auth: Login needed or the link expired
st.gone: The file is no longer on the server
st.html: Server sent an HTML page · login needed?
st.timeout: The server is answering too slowly
st.reparse: This folder cannot be used (junction or link)
st.badRange: The server sent wrong data · stopped to protect the file

why.blocked: Windows Security or your antivirus removed or refused this file. GDM never gave it its final name. If you trust the source, check Windows Security.
why.unprotected: This folder (exFAT/FAT or a network share) cannot record that the file came from the internet, so Windows will not warn when it is opened. Use an NTFS folder for programs.
why.tls: The connection was refused to protect you. GDM has no “ignore” button.
why.insecure: The server tried to switch from https to http or to a route GDM does not allow. GDM stopped and there is no way around it.

d.limit: Speed limit for this file (KB/s, 0 = none)

banner.restored: The list was restored from backup {{name}} · downloads found on disk were recovered
banner.readonly: This list comes from a newer GDM · opened read-only

banner.updReady: Update {{v}} is ready · installs when GDM is idle

set.startupS: Runs quietly in the tray (browsers also start GDM when needed)
set.silentS: Blocked files and decisions are still shown
set.folderS: Each category has its own sub-folder
set.connsS: Starts at 2 and adds more while speed rises
set.info: Show the info dialog for browser downloads
set.infoS: Like IDM: downloading starts while the dialog is open
set.limitS: For hotspots with a data cap
set.catchS: The extension sends only the link, the name and that site's cookie
set.skip: Sites never caught (* = anything, one per line)
set.videoS: Off by default · arrives in P2
set.updModeS: Automatic: checks daily, downloads in the background, installs when GDM is idle
set.store: Updates come from the Microsoft Store
set.privacyText: GDM has no telemetry, no account and no user ID. The only request GDM makes by itself is the update check (GET latest.json from GitHub), and you can turn it off.
set.clipboardS: Off by default · arrives in P2

ob.p1: You can change these later in Settings.
ob.p2: Install the extension so GDM can catch downloads from your browser.

ob.clipS: Catch links you copy (arrives in P2)
